verification_rule: A VERIFIED claim must name the claim type and include claim-appropriate evidence. Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN.
stale_rule: A recorded claim tied to a repository source scope, deployment, test run, or evidence artifact is STALE when the authoritative current source for that claim no longer matches its recorded identity. Unrelated control-plane/documentation commits do not invalidate a proof whose claim-relevant source scope remains unchanged.
proof_authority: Evidence outranks assertions; current authoritative sources outrank historical records.
freshness_rule: Recorded runtime/policy evidence is CURRENT when the exact claim-relevant source paths match the deployed/tested source identity and the evidence artifact remains valid. Full repository HEAD equality is not required when the claim scope excludes unrelated control-plane or documentation changes; the source-scope identity must be recorded explicitly.
